text: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is a listed company: its common shares are registered under the symbol CLF on the New York Stock Exchange. Its 2026 proxy statement names BlackRock, Inc., with 44,103,832 common shares (7.73% of the class), in its table of persons known to the company to beneficially own more than five percent of its outstanding common shares.
